name: Bleap Physical Plastic Card
summary: A standard physical plastic debit card for global in-store payments and ATM withdrawals, directly linked to your self-custodial on-chain balance. Bleap Card Benefits * Up to 20% cashback on selected categories: * Gaming (Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Twitch) * Streaming (Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime, YouTube Premium) * AI subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) * 3% cashback on: * Uber, Bolt * Uber Eats, Glovo, Just Eat, Deliveroo * 2% cashback on: * Restaurants * Supermarkets * 1% cashback on all other eligible purchases * Cashback paid automatically in USDC * No monthly cashback cap on the standard cashback program * Accepted worldwide anywhere Mastercard is accepted * Apple Pay and Google Pay support * No foreign exchange (FX) fees when spending abroad * Market-rate EUR ↔️ USD conversion * Free ATM withdrawals up to EUR 400/month * Non-custodial account architecture * Users keep control of their assets * MPC (Multi-Party Computation) security model * Free crypto on-ramp options * Bank transfers * Crypto transfers

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Bleap Physical Plastic Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Bleap Physical Plastic Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
